changelog: **IdP metadata import, certificate expiry warnings and Test connection for SAML SSO (#1933):** `POST /api/admin/organizations/[id]/sso/metadata` reads an IdP's SAML metadata (pasted, uploaded or by URL) and answers with a preview — issuer, HTTP-Redirect entry point, signing certificate with fingerprint and expiry, SLO URL — that the Enterprise SSO card fills into its fields; the save still goes through `PATCH /api/admin/organizations`, and the route is a super admin's like that write (#1575). Parsing is `src/lib/ssoMetadata.ts` on `@xmldom/xmldom` (now a direct, exact-pinned dependency): 256 KiB cap and any DOCTYPE/ENTITY refused (XXE); a URL is fetched through the SSRF guard on every redirect hop with a 5s timeout (`src/lib/ssoFetch.ts`). `validateSsoConfig()` now refuses an unparseable or expired certificate when a request writes one or switches SSO on. The card shows the stored certificate's expiry as a badge, `POST …/sso/test` runs the read-only half of a sign-in (config, certificate, AuthnRequest, entry point reachable) without minting a session, and the daily `sso-certificates` job (`/api/cron?job=sso-certificates`) mails the org's admins and support address at 30 and 7 days — once each per certificate, recorded in the new nullable `Organization.ssoCertWarnFp` / `ssoCertWarnStage`, category `sso-certificate` (essential).

en: Single sign-on setup can now import your identity provider's metadata file or URL, warns 30 and 7 days before its certificate expires, and has a Test connection button.
tr: Tek oturum açma kurulumu artık kimlik sağlayıcının metadata dosyasını veya adresini içe aktarabiliyor, sertifikanın süresi dolmadan 30 ve 7 gün önce uyarıyor ve bir Bağlantıyı test et düğmesi sunuyor.
de: Die Single-Sign-on-Einrichtung kann jetzt die Metadaten-Datei oder -URL Ihres Identity Providers importieren, warnt 30 und 7 Tage vor Ablauf des Zertifikats und bietet eine Schaltfläche „Verbindung testen“.
